blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) on Tuesday released new mugshots of former House Speaker and incumbent Leyte 1st District Rep. Martin Romualdez. Romualdez was transferred to the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas on Monday night upon an order by the Sandiganbayan Third Division. READ: Court orders Romualdez
